name: Ghostscript
summary: An interpreter for PostScript and PDF, and converter between them and images

modules.name: ghostscript
build: sed -i '/just define a dummy here for Windows/{n;n;s/^#ifdef _WIN32$/#if defined(_WIN32) \&\& !defined(__MINGW32__)/}' base/mkromfs.c

sh ./configure --build=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix="$PREFIX" --without-tesseract --disable-cups --without-ijs --disable-contrib --without-x --disable-fontconfig --disable-dbus --without-libpaper --without-libidn --disable-gtk ac_executable_extensions=.exe ac_cv_prog_MAKE_EXISTS=yes > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 config.log; exit 1; }
make directories > make.log 2>&1 && make >> make.log 2>&1 || { tail -80 make.log; exit 1; }
